quests.title: The Ash and the Cinderling
quests.summary: The Observatory needs an ash sample, a look at a young cinderling, and a trespassing tourist sent home.

steps.text: Scoop an ash sample at the drift on Garibaldi Hill.
Take the sample to the Volcanologist at the Observatory.
Catch a cinderling on the southern slopes and show the Volcanologist.
Send Ash Tourist Mallon home from the edge of Plymouth, then report back.

quests.reward: A Piece of Pumice (a charm: hearth moves hurt less).
